6.2.rationale: The provided passages discuss general protection of women and children victims of violence and list trafficking only in the context of children (kidnapping/sale/trafficking). There is no explicit or implicit special protection targeted at women victims of human trafficking in the shown text.

6.3.rationale: While women’s empowerment includes job training and productive economic enterprises, the passages do not specifically mention women workers/employees or workplace-related protections; they address general empowerment and protection.

6.4.rationale: None of the passages mention elderly women or provide special protection measures targeted to older women; they only address women generally and family participation/health access broadly.

6.5.rationale: Disability is mentioned only for children (“children with disabilities”) under special protection. There is no mention of women with disabilities or people with disabilities generally as a targeted group in the provided passages.

6.6.rationale: The passages do not mention women heads of household/families or any tailored protection measures for them; they address women generally and family participation broadly.

6.7.rationale: Minority/isolated groups are referenced only for children (“children from minority and isolated groups”). No passages provide special protection measures targeted at women from minority or isolated groups.

6.8.rationale: The passages do not mention women in conflict with the law (as witnesses or perpetrators) or any legal-process-specific protections for women. The only ‘conflict with the law’ reference shown applies to children.

6.9.rationale: None of the passages explicitly mention Indigenous peoples/groups (masyarakat adat) or provide targeted protection measures for them. The closest reference is to “minority and isolated groups” for children, which is not explicitly Indigenous and not a targeted measure for Indigenous groups generally.

6.10.rationale: The passages include safe house services for victims of violence and special protection for children in emergency situations, but do not mention refugees, forced displacement, or targeted measures for displaced persons.

6.11.rationale: No passages mention domestic workers or provide protections specifically targeted at domestic workers; the text shown is general to women/children victims of violence and empowerment.

6.12.rationale: Although safe houses are mentioned for victims of violence, there is no mention of homelessness or special protection measures specifically targeted at women experiencing homelessness.

6.13.rationale: None of the passages mention former inmates/correctional institutions or formerly incarcerated women, nor any tailored protection measures for this group.
